messages:
maya: Heads up — prepping the cutover for api:v3 -> runtime:v7 -> console:v2 -> router:v5 this quiet window. Can we do a quick preflight for canary telemetry gating? I want explicit roll/fail criteria before we pin.
andre: +1. What are the canary slices and metrics we care about? latency, error-rate, and tail-p99s? Also need token-level cost delta for runtime quantization change.
jin: Canary slices: 1% initial traffic to eu-west, then 5% goal. Metrics: 1) 500/4xx spike > 0.5% absolute, 2) latency p95 increase > 40ms, 3) error budget burn > 20% in 10m. Also watch kv cache hit rate and stream connection churn for router.
luca: For console schema changes we've gated on schema-compat check + rollout flag. Confirm console will accept api:v3 responses with the new metadata field. jess, did QA sign off on output shape? 
jess: QA validated shape for the fields used by console. Minor extra metadata OK (console ignores unknown keys). We still need a smoke test after router pin to ensure header split doesn't drop trace-id.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Preflight checklist triggered by @maya. Jobs queued: orch-dryrun, telemetry-smoke, canary-routing-check. ETA: ~6m for dryrun. Use /deploy status 7999991234 for live updates.
maya: Thanks. Andre: can you post the quick rollback playbook here? Keep the steps minimal — we need to be able to rollback runtime and router independently if necessary.
andre: Rollback playbook (short):
- Step 1: Pause traffic to new router variant: deployctl pin router:v4 and mark new variant drained.
- Step 2: Runtime: cut traffic back to runtime:v6 via routing policy (rollback-tag: stable). If runtime rollback alone, keep router pinned to v5 but route runtime to v6.
- Step 3: Console: unpin console rollout, revert schema flag.
- Step 4: Revoke canary token slices and run post-rollback smoke across API/console.
- Step 5: Postmortem & metric snapshot at rollback time.
(Use /run rollback-playbook 7999991234 to execute automations.)
jin: Add emergency metric-based auto-rollback trigger: if 500s exceed 0.75% for 5m OR p95 delta > 80ms for 3m => auto-rollback. Ops SLOs allow that.
luca: Also add a manual hold trigger: if console telemetry shows missing trace-id in >0.1% of sessions for 10m, we hold and investigate. Console team will post a dump URL for 5 affected sessions.
maya: Sound plan. deploy-bot — when dryrun done, can you post the canary-routing-check results and the telemetry-smoke graph link? I want the p95/p99 times and KV cache hit %.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: orch-dryrun finished: no config conflicts. canary-routing-check running. telemetry-smoke results: p95 delta +12ms, p99 delta +28ms, kv-cache-hit stable at 92%. Full graphs: https://graphs.redwood/7999991234/smoke
jess: Smoke looks clean. I'll stand by to run console header-sanity after router pin. ETA 3m.
andre: I pushed a small header-preserve shim in router:v5 just in case. It's behind a rollout flag. If we see trace-id strips, flip flag off and rollback router.
maya: Good. Final ask: annotate release notes with the rollback triggers and the console schema note. I'll draft release notes and ping product.
jin: I'll set canary slice schedule: 00:00 -> 01:00 1% eu-west, 01:00 -> 02:00 5% global. Manual gate before 10%.
maya: Ok commencing pin window in 2m. If anyone sees anything odd, call out in this thread and hit /run rollback-playbook 7999991234 if thresholds breach.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary routing at 1% to eu-west is live — traffic ID 7999991234-001. Telemetry pipeline streaming. Monitoring: https://graphs.redwood/7999991234/live
jess: Console header-sanity check passed on first 50 sessions.
luca: Router shim flag checked — no trace-id drops observed in the first 15m.
andre: keeping eyes on runtime token-cost delta — so far +2% unit cost during canary. within expected range.
maya: Great work team. We'll hold for the 1-hour window then reassess for 5% expansion. If all green, we'll proceed with pin and rollout notes update. :thumbsup:
